name: paldora
description: A box for your people: a privacy-first living scrapbook for real friends and private communities.

scripts.test:integration: node scripts/with-test-database.mjs pnpm turbo run test:integration --concurrency=1
scripts.firebase:local:flow:test: pnpm turbo run build --filter=@paldora/firebase-functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-paldora --config firebase.native.json 'pnpm --filter @paldora/firebase-functions test:integration'
scripts.firebase:native:test: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-paldora --config firebase.native.json 'pnpm --filter @paldora/firebase-native test:rules'
scripts.test:e2e:full: turbo run build --filter=@paldora/api --filter=@paldora/worker --filter=@paldora/web^... && node scripts/with-test-database.mjs playwright test -c apps/web/e2e/playwright.fullstack.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:personalization: turbo run build --filter=@paldora/api --filter=@paldora/worker --filter=@paldora/web^... && node scripts/with-test-database.mjs playwright test -c apps/web/e2e/playwright.personalization.config.ts
